text_en: To the leader. Of the Korahites. According to Alamoth. A Song.
text_cn: 科辣黑后裔的诗歌，交与乐官，女声高音。

text_en: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
text_cn: 天主是我们的救助和力量， 是患难中最易寻到的保障。

text_en: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth should change, though the mountains shake in the heart of the sea;
text_cn: 因此，纵使地动山崩，堕入海心， 我们也绝不会疑惧横生；

text_en: though its waters roar and foam, though the mountains tremble with its tumult. Selah
text_cn: 海涛尽管汹涌翻腾， 山岳尽管因浪震动： 与我们同在的，是万军的天主， 雅各伯的天主是我们的保护。 （休止）

text_en: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy habitation of the Most High.
text_cn: 河流要使天主的城邑欢乐， 即至高者所住的至圣居所，

text_en: God is in the midst of the city; it shall not be moved; God will help it when the morning dawns.
text_cn: 天主定居其中，此城决不动摇； 清晨曙光一现，天主即加扶牢。

text_en: The nations are in an uproar, the kingdoms totter; he utters his voice, the earth melts.
text_cn: 异民尽管扰乱，万邦尽管骚动， 天主一发喝声，大地即刻消溶。

text_en: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah
text_cn: 与我们同在的，是万军的上主， 雅各伯的天主是我们的保护。（休止）

text_en: Come, behold the works of the Lord ; see what desolations he has brought on the earth.
text_cn: 请你们前来观看上主的作为， 看他在地上所行的惊人事迹：

text_en: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth; he breaks the bow, and shatters the spear; he burns the shields with fire.
text_cn: 他消灭战争直达地极， 他断弓毁矛，烧甲焚盔。

text_en: “Be still, and know that I am God! I am exalted among the nations, I am exalted in the earth. ”
text_cn: “你们要停手！应承认我是天主， 是万民的至尊，是大地的上主。”

text_en: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah
text_cn: 与我们同在的，是万军的上主， 雅各伯的天主是我们的保护。 (休止)
